card.name: Linking words before interacting drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (with, as, of, comma) right before a named interacting drug, usually a CYP3A4 inhibitor or inducer such as ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir or rifampin.

modes.label: With / such as
modes.description: Linking words after co-administration or inhibitor terms that lead into a named interacting drug.
modes.example: Leniolisib exposure was increased 2-fold when co-administered<< with>> itraconazole, a strong C

modes.label: Of before dose and drug
modes.description: The word of in a dose or presence phrase just before the interacting drug.
modes.example: In a study of 18 healthy subjects, 80 mg toremifene once daily coadministered with 200 mg<< of>> ketoconazole twice daily increased the to

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word interaction and related forms, as in drug interaction text.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a drug that is named as interacting with the one being described.
